interface.name: noctalia_foreign_parent_manager_v1
interface.description: This protocol associates a native portal dialog with the requesting application's X11 window. It grants no general parent, focus, or window management authority. The compositor authenticates the Wayland peer as the current Noctalia portal backend and checks the original broker-supplied unique bus sender against authoritative XRes ownership of the parent. Clients must not attach the child's initial buffer before the ready event. Unsupported or unprovable sandbox/proxy ownership is rejected.

arg.name: request_sender
arg.summary: original unique bus sender from authenticated broker request

interface.name: noctalia_foreign_parent_v1
interface.description: Exactly one lease may exist per child wl_surface. The child must belong to this client and be an unmapped xdg_toplevel. Ownership validation is asynchronous and bounded; ready precedes mapping. Rejection, parent loss, or child destruction makes the lease inert. Destroying the lease clears only its own association and modal input restriction. Clients close the dialog on rejection or parent_lost. The parent window is never closed.
